name: 코일
scene: In a clean electrical substation courtyard at blue hour, poised standing front three-quarter card stance, both hands relaxed open beside her hips. Cool reflections and thin warm rim lighting.
casual: At an evening retro science exhibition, presenting a tabletop electrostatic demonstration with one palm open beside a glass sphere, other hand naturally resting on the table. Indigo and magenta spotlights, no audience.

Original adult science-show host event outfit: opaque silver fitted halter bodice with blue piping, high-waisted red tailored short shorts and a short decorative capelet resting on shoulders. Bare arms shoulders and a small midriff gap, tiny magnet earrings.

Inside a rainy attic music room at late afternoon, sitting on a low window cushion with one knee raised, sorting blank vinyl sleeves onto a small wooden crate. Both hands visible resting on separate sleeve corners, head and bare feet inside frame.
Slate sleeveless button-front linen top, cobalt loose short culottes, bare arms shoulders legs, tiny red hair pin.

At a bright open-air orchard juice station at sunny noon, pressing a halved citrus onto a broad manual juicer with one open hand while the other steadies the wide bowl. Fruit baskets and striped shade canopy.
Red sleeveless square-neck summer dress with a securely fitted bodice and short flared hem, blue waist apron, bare arms shoulders and legs. Tiny silver circular necklace.

comparison.changes: Different locations, specific activities, clothing silhouettes and compositions; mandatory categories alternate event fashion, lingerie and swimwear.

method: Actual Preact generator controls selected through repository DOM harness; output read once per asset.
